result.rationale: The migration inserts raw site-setting strings (e.g. 'http://discourse.org') directly via SQL INSERT, bypassing EmbeddableHost's before_validation that strips 'https?://'. record_for_host then queries where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host), so stored values with protocols can never match a referer host, and embed_controller's ensure_embeddable raises Discourse::InvalidAccess for previously-working hosts after upgrade.

judged_text: Migration inserts host values un-normalized, breaking previously-working embeds: raw strings like http://discourse.org are copied into host via SQL, bypassing the model's before_validation normalization, so record_for_host's lower(host) = uri.host comparison can never match referer host discourse.org; after upgrade, embeds on those sites fail with Discourse::InvalidAccess (invalid referer host) with no hint why, until an admin manually re-saves each host.
